name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore, Beached Sea Turtle remains wash ashore in growing numbers. Their bones give Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine specimens to study as Kalimdor's marine life dwindles.

sections.title: A Strand of Bones
sections.body: Great sea creatures and turtles lie along Darkshore's shore. Many ancient turtles drift onto the shoals or crawl onto the sand to die. Greymist murlocs gather at the carcasses and strip away the flesh. Soon, only shell and bone remain, beside crude camps they make there.

sections.title: Vanishing Waters
sections.body:
Before the Third War, sea turtles thrived in the sacred waters around Mount Hyjal and the roots of Nordrassil, the World Tree. After Nordrassil's sacrifice against the Burning Legion and Teldrassil's planting off Kalimdor's northern shore, their numbers collapsed.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde and other priestesses of Elune study the remains for the Temple of the Moon. They seek to learn whether dark magic, changing seas, or the loss of the turtles' ancient sanctuary drives them to their deaths.

faq.q: Why are sea turtles beaching themselves in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The night elves do not know why sea turtles beach themselves. They once thrived in the waters beneath Nordrassil, the World Tree. Since Nordrassil's destruction in the Third War and the raising of Teldrassil, their numbers have plummeted, and many seem to end their lives along Darkshore's shoals by choice.

aliases: where to turn in turtle remains
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf scholar and representative of the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine. She catalogs and studies washed-up sea creatures to uncover why Darkshore's wildlife is suffering.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the turtle remains?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs scavenge the enormous carcasses for food and materials. They often make shoreline settlements beside beached sea turtles and other sea creatures, then strip the remains clean.

faq.q: What connection do these turtles have to Nordrassil?
faq.answer: Night elves say sea turtles were once common in the pristine waters around Mount Hyjal and Nordrassil, the World Tree. Nordrassil's violent destruction disrupted the natural balance, and sightings of the turtles fell sharply afterward.

faq.q: Does Teldrassil have anything to do with their decline?
faq.answer: The priesthood has seen sea turtles in ever-decreasing numbers since Teldrassil began to grow. The Temple of the Moon studies whether the new World Tree has altered coastal currents, disrupted migration, or bears an unnatural aura that affects ocean life.

faq.q: Are there multiple beached creatures along Darkshore?
faq.answer: Yes. Darkshore's long coastline holds many beached sea creatures and turtles. Each carcass offers bone and tissue samples for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde to study as she pieces together the ecological disaster unfolding along the shore.

angles.text: For a druid, these ancient ocean dwellers stranded on shore signal nature out of balance after the battle at Mount Hyjal and Teldrassil's arrival.
As a night elf, you know the Temple of the Moon seeks to honor and understand the creatures that once played beneath Nordrassil's boughs.
As a priest, you help the Sisterhood of Elune diagnose the spiritual sickness spreading through Kalimdor's waters by retrieving these remains.
